question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
clarification: Count each distinct CustomerID only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'

d.request: What is the percentage of customers who used EUR on 2012-08-25, counting each distinct CustomerID only once?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS eur_percentage FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'

b.request: Of all distinct customers who had a transaction on 2012-08-25 (counting each CustomerID once), what percentage have Currency = 'EUR' in the customers table?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k t LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'

c.request:
What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
Evidence: '2012/8/25' can be represented by '2012-08-25'
Count each distinct CustomerID only once.
c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage FROM transactions_1k t INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
